headline: Muslims to get land ownership in Makkah and Madinah for the first time in history
summary: This historic decision marks a significant shift in property rights within Islam's holiest cities, allowing individuals to own land for the first time.
details: For the first time in history, Muslims are being granted land ownership in the holy cities of Makkah and Madinah. This marks an unprecedented development in property rights within these sacred locations.
This historic decision allows individuals of the Muslim faith to acquire land in the revered cities, a practice that has not been permitted before.
The move signifies a new chapter for land management and individual property rights in Makkah and Madinah, as reported by Somoy News.

headline: Pagla Mosque sets new donation record, nearly BDT 16 crore collected
summary: Pagla Mosque in Kishoreganj has broken its previous record, collecting an unprecedented nearly BDT 16 crore in donations. This significant sum highlights the mosque's continued public appeal.
details: Pagla Mosque has set a new record for donations, with approximately BDT 16 crore collected. This marks the highest amount ever received by the mosque.
The substantial collection, comprising a large volume of currency notes, was meticulously counted. This record highlights the continued generosity of devotees towards the mosque.
